title: Channels
content:
# Channels

Channels are the pipes that connect concurrent goroutines. You can send values into channels from one goroutine and receive those values into another goroutine.

**Unbuffered channels** provide synchronization. **Buffered channels** allow sending a limited number of values without a corresponding receiver.

```go
a := [3]int{1, 2, 3} // Array
s := []int{1, 2, 3}  // Slice
```

# Slices vs Arrays

- **Arrays** have a fixed size defined at compile time.
- **Slices** are a dynamically-sized, flexible view into the elements of an array. In practice, slices are much more common than arrays.

```go
a := [3]int{1, 2, 3} // Array
s := []int{1, 2, 3}  // Slice
```
